alternative_explanations: A small behavioral probe set may collide on the unseen near operator and cause false reuse.
Exact canonical-table caching may remain cheaper once probe acquisition, cache compilation and state are fully charged.
confounds: The evaluator exposes executable finite tables, so success could be finite-domain amortization rather than open-world representation discovery.
One runner-random seed estimates no seed variance and the local-visible synthetic cohort is screening evidence only.
falsification_criteria: Discard if any shared warm, near-equivalent, new-fact or retention accuracy is below 1, or false reuse is nonzero, in any cell.
Discard unless shared mean warm query operations strictly decrease from exposure 1 to 4 and from 4 to 16 at each K without increasing with K.
Discard if either source-identical ablation matches the full qualitative conjunction, state exceeds 4194304 bytes, or an implementable control Pareto-dominates shared after full cost.
Invalidate on evaluator, manifest, preflight, baseline or source-identity mismatch; primitive labels, target leakage, post-score tuning, external model/API use, or omitted cost.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any overlap between the length-one/two training programs and the held-out length-four composition.
Invalidate if primitive labels, native source families or evaluator canonical tables reach an implementable candidate.
Invalidate unless positive re-encodings are raw-distinct and exact-equivalent and pair-breaking negatives change the operator.
Invalidate if scoring conjugation or any runner-random program is realized before integrity and source audit.
Invalidate on target access before prediction, post-score tuning, state-budget breach or evaluator-integrity change.
Invalidate if exposure 1, 4 and 16 costs are extrapolated instead of measured through fresh re-encodings.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify this exact counterexample-probe compiler and end the direction without tuning.
outcome_policy.null: Return HYP-0030 to dormant and do not vary probe count, cache thresholds or fingerprint rule.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep only as a scout-selected mechanism and design an unchanged stronger adversarial replication; do not promote or tune.

predicted_outcome: Shared compiler is exact on warm, near-equivalent, mutation and retention checks with zero false reuse in all nine K-by-exposure cells; its warm operations strictly fall from exposure 1 to 4 to 16 at every K, remain bounded with K, and are Pareto non-dominated.
promotion_criteria: A one-seed visible synthetic scout cannot promote or mark promising; a conjunctive positive can only select the unchanged mechanism for a later stronger preregistered cohort.
research_question: Can labeled behavioral counterexamples teach one anonymous compiler a bounded reusable fingerprint that preserves exactness and lowers warm inference work with experience on an unseen length-four composition?
title: Counterexample-learned operator compiler quick
